content: Parked my Yamaha FZ-S V3 (KA-05-EV-7788) at Indiranagar Metro Station paid parking lot at 8:00 PM on 5th August 2026. Returned next morning at 8:00 AM to find the handlebar lock broken and the motorcycle stolen. Immediately searched nearby areas and registered an FIR at Indiranagar Police Station at 11:30 AM.

metadata.author: Vikram R
metadata.action_taken: Immediate police FIR and insurer intimation
